_comment: engine: voicestudio | edge | openai | elevenlabs. Run 'python scripts/voice.py --list-voices' to see what your engine offers. Write these lines to be HEARD, not read.

scenes.text: Most vertical videos lose the viewer in the first two seconds.
The hook is the whole job. If your first sentence doesn't create a question in someone's head, nothing after it gets watched.
Three that work: name the mistake out loud, promise one specific outcome, or start in the middle of the story and explain later.
And remember: around eighty percent of people watch with the sound off. If your captions are missing, so is your message.
Build it in code, and changing a line takes seconds instead of an afternoon.
